intended_object: For a continuous map f : X → Y and an open set V ⊆ Y, the restriction f|_{f⁻¹(V)} : f⁻¹(V) → V of f to the preimage, viewed as a morphism of open subspaces in TopCat. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition sends x ∈ f⁻¹(V) to ⟨f x, x.2⟩ ∈ V. This is exactly the restriction of f to the preimage. It is continuous because f composed with the subtype inclusion is continuous, and the map then lands in the subtype V. The setting is natural: any continuous map in TopCat and any open set of the codomain. At the level of underlying functions it agrees with Mathlib's `Set.restrictPreimage` (whose continuity is `Continuous.restrictPreimage`). Here it is packaged as a TopCat morphism between the open-subspace objects `(Opens.toTopCat _).obj _`, which the library needs for its categorical constructions. There is no error and no needless loss of generality.
